coach.description: One or two sentences to the learner about how the plan is built.

lessons.description: 3 to 12 short lessons, easiest first. NeoKeys builds each lesson's notes from the song itself.

id.description: Short kebab-case id, unique in the plan, e.g. a-tune.

why.description: One sentence shown before the lesson.

bars.description: [first, last] bar, inclusive, 1-based, inside the song.

hand.description: Which hand practice mode waits for.

transform.description: original = the song's notes for that hand (both = everything); melody = right-hand top line only; block_chords = one held left-hand triad per chord change, from chordsPerBar; melody_and_chords = both of those together.

tempoPct.description: Percent of the song's tempo, 40 to 110.

loops.description: Times the bars repeat in the lesson, 1 to 4.

accuracyPct.description: Notes hit out of notes expected, 60 to 100.

maxWrong.description: Wrong notes allowed in one run.

onFail.description: What to offer after a failed run: try again, 10% slower, or one hand at a time.
